purpose: one bounded scaling pilot of a no-downsample tile adapter trained through the frozen d64 SocketMatcher for exact-neighbour retrieval

no_repeat_boundary.fullres_boundary_denoiser: same stride-one NAF family, but the prior model used boundary pixel reconstruction and regressed direct retrieval
no_repeat_boundary.e13: prior exact-retrieval model was a standalone four-pixel border CNN; this pilot injects the ranking loss through the much stronger frozen full-tile/contextual d64 SocketMatcher
no_repeat_boundary.drunet_and_dualnaf: prior generic restoration checkpoints were fixed matcher views and were not trained for neighbour ranking
no_repeat_boundary.restored_border_ranker: prior learned shortlist cross-ranker used a downsampling DRUNet view rather than an end-to-end no-downsample adapter
forbidden_repeats: standalone E13 width or step sweep

objective.retrieval: frozen Socket partial-OT bidirectional exact-neighbour NLL plus raw row/column listwise CE
objective.boundary_guard: border Charbonnier + finite differences + normalised shape + weak dirty identity
objective.target_labels: known exact synthetic permutation of organizer-train clean source only

evaluation.candidate: adapter view through the same frozen d64 partial-OT

local_decoder_gate_final_step400.supply: raw-top32 union coverage gain >= 0.01 independently on right and down
local_decoder_gate_final_step400.ranking: pooled R@1 gain >= 0.005 and pooled R@5 gain >= 0
local_decoder_gate_final_step400.precision: matched reciprocal precision gain >= 0.03 at matched coverage >= 0.03

terminal_transfer_gate.supply: right and down raw-top32 union coverage gains both >= 0
terminal_transfer_gate.ranking: pooled R@1 and R@5 gains both >= 0
terminal_transfer_gate.precision: matched reciprocal precision gain >= 0 at matched coverage >= 0.03
